description:
**When to use**: You applied for a job with apply_job and no longer want it, while its window is still open.

Withdraw your pending application for a job while its application window is open (409 applications_closed after). You may apply again before the close. Mirrors DELETE /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/applications/me.
name: withdraw_application
title: Withdraw your application (ALIP-0083)
